issues.detail: Article Figure 2 labels the cyclic triazolyl intermediate 4; forward Scheme 2 and SI label that structure 15 and reserve 4 for the cyclic iodide. Compound identities use forward-scheme numbering.
issues.subject: 4 versus 15

issues.detail: The substrate name is copied from a phenoxy compound, but label 5, amount/mmol, forward schemes and product 4 identify the iodinated precursor. This conflict is retained; the name is not used to replace the graph.
issues.subject: SI paragraph 87

issues.detail: SI reports calculated 371.9702 for C14H11IO4 but found 369.9703; neutral graph mass is about 369.9702. Original values are retained.
SI reports calculated 313.0906 for C16H13N3O4 but found 311.0907; neutral graph mass is about 311.0906. Original values are retained.
The 13C list for ketone 6 duplicates the list for chromone 12. That list is not used as independent structure confirmation.
SI procedure yields 72.3/77.5/73.4 percent differ from rounded scheme labels 72/78/73; dataset uses procedure values.
issues.subject: E01/E04/E06

issues.detail: Article Scheme 1 reports 3 h while the SI scheme says 4 h; procedure includes cooling/addition intervals. A single harmonized duration is not asserted.
issues.subject: E01

issues.detail: 6 plus 11 to 12 comprises condensation followed by iodination. No structure is drawn for the unisolated internal species, so no intermediate SMILES is invented.
issues.subject: E04
